_provenance: Extracted verbatim from supabase/migrations/20260614100400_seed_negation_station.sql. That migration is authoritative; this file exists only so the dev lab and the tests have the items without database access. It is deliberately NOT in content/, because Negation Station predates the seed pipeline and must never be re-seeded.

items.prompt: Every river in this region flows north.
credited_answers: At least one river in this region does not flow north.
items.explanation: To negate "every," show just one counterexample.

items.prompt: You can graduate only if you pass all your final exams.
credited_answers: You can graduate without passing all your final exams.
items.explanation: The necessity is challenged; graduation can occur without passing all exams.

items.prompt: Pollution causes the depletion of the ozone layer.
credited_answers: Pollution does not necessarily cause the depletion of the ozone layer.
items.explanation: To negate causation, raise the possibility that depletion happens without pollution as the cause.

items.prompt: Most of the committee members support the new policy.
credited_answers: Half or fewer of the committee members support the new policy.
items.explanation: To negate "most" (majority), say the support does not reach a majority.

items.prompt: It is generally agreed that caffeine improves focus.
credited_answers: It is not generally agreed that caffeine improves focus.
items.explanation: Negate the consensus claim by showing lack of general agreement.

items.prompt: All books in the library are available for borrowing.
credited_answers: At least one book in the library is not available for borrowing.
items.explanation: Negate "all" by allowing for one exception.

items.prompt: If the store is open, then you will find the product in stock.
credited_answers: The store can be open without the product being in stock.
items.explanation: Negate by showing the sufficient condition without the necessary.

items.prompt: The lecture is generally interesting to all students.
credited_answers: The lecture is not generally interesting to all students.
items.explanation: Negate the generality by suggesting some students do not find it interesting.

items.prompt: No pets are allowed in the building.
credited_answers: At least one pet is allowed in the building.
items.explanation: Negate "no" by providing one exception.

items.prompt: If a plant needs water, then its leaves will droop.
credited_answers: A plant can need water without its leaves drooping.
items.explanation: Negate by separating the sufficient from the necessary.

items.prompt: All forms of higher education lead to better societal understanding and cultural empathy.
credited_answers: At least one form of higher education does not lead to better societal understanding or cultural empathy.
items.explanation: Negate "all" with a single counterexample.

items.prompt: The increase in global temperatures results solely from human industrial activities over the past century.
credited_answers: Global temperatures can increase for reasons other than human industrial activities over the past century.
items.explanation: Negate sole causation by pointing to other possible causes.

items.prompt: Most nutritional experts agree that intermittent fasting is the superior method for weight loss compared to other diets.
credited_answers: Fewer than a majority of nutritional experts agree that intermittent fasting is the superior method for weight loss.
items.explanation: Negate "most" by reducing it below majority.

items.prompt: If and only if historical texts are preserved, will future generations understand past societies.
credited_answers: Future generations can understand past societies even without preserving historical texts.
items.explanation: Negate by allowing the outcome without the condition.

items.prompt: Typically, countries with vast natural resources enjoy higher economic prosperity than those with limited resources.
credited_answers: It is not typically true that countries with vast natural resources enjoy higher prosperity than those with limited resources.
items.explanation: Negate by denying the general tendency.

items.prompt: Every instance of financial instability within the market leads to a decline in consumer confidence, as historically supported by data from the past several decades.
credited_answers: There are instances of financial instability that do not lead to a decline in consumer confidence.
items.explanation: Negate "every" with at least one counterexample.

items.prompt: The exclusive reliance on fossil fuels for energy production inevitably results in catastrophic environmental disasters, a consensus reached by environmental scientists globally.
credited_answers: Fossil fuels can be relied upon for energy production without inevitably causing catastrophic environmental disasters.
items.explanation: Negate inevitability by allowing a case where disaster does not occur.

items.prompt: Most authors, when asked about writer's block, conclude that it stems from the pressure to produce content that perpetually meets the highest literary standards.
credited_answers: Less than a majority of authors conclude that writer's block stems from pressure to meet the highest standards.
items.explanation: Negate "most" by reducing it below majority.

items.prompt: Continental drift is solely responsible for all tectonic shifts observed in the Earth's crust, as evidenced by geological research spanning decades.
credited_answers: Some tectonic shifts are caused by factors other than continental drift.
items.explanation: Negate sole causation by suggesting additional causes.

items.prompt: All reputable journalism follows strict ethical guidelines set forth by international press councils, ensuring unbiased and factual reporting in all situations.
credited_answers: Some reputable journalism does not follow the strict ethical guidelines set forth by international press councils.
items.explanation: Negate "all" by allowing an exception.

items.prompt: If economic sanctions are imposed, then the targeted nation will experience a significant reduction in its global trade volume.
credited_answers: Economic sanctions can be imposed without significantly reducing the targeted nation's global trade volume.
items.explanation: Negate by showing the condition without the outcome.

items.prompt: Without formal education, an individual cannot master the intricate nuances of language comprehension and usage, a necessity for advanced literacy.
credited_answers: An individual can master the intricate nuances of language comprehension and usage without formal education.
items.explanation: Negate the claimed necessity by showing the outcome without the requirement.

items.prompt: Typically, advancements in technology result in increased efficiency within industrial processes, benefiting overall productivity.
credited_answers: It is not typically true that advancements in technology result in increased efficiency within industrial processes.
items.explanation: Negate the general trend.

items.prompt: The sole purpose of establishing international treaties is to promote and maintain global peace, as historically documented by diplomatic correspondences.
credited_answers: International treaties are sometimes established for purposes other than promoting and maintaining global peace.
items.explanation: Negate exclusivity by suggesting other purposes exist.

items.prompt: It is necessary to have universal healthcare to achieve equitable health outcomes in diverse populations, according to numerous public health studies.
credited_answers: Equitable health outcomes in diverse populations can be achieved without universal healthcare.
items.explanation: Negate necessity by showing the outcome without the condition.

items.prompt: Every comprehensive urban development plan in modern cities incorporates elements that aim to enhance green spaces alongside transportation infrastructures while ensuring minimal environmental impact.
credited_answers: At least one comprehensive urban development plan in a modern city does not incorporate those elements.
items.explanation: Negate "every" with one exception.

items.prompt: Most analytical frameworks employed in the field of sociology draw upon interdisciplinary methodologies to provide insights into complex social dynamics that traditional approaches might overlook.
credited_answers: Fewer than a majority of analytical frameworks in sociology draw upon interdisciplinary methodologies.
items.explanation: Negate "most" by reducing it below majority.

items.prompt: A significant portion of contemporary philosophical discourse revolves around the reevaluation of classical theories in light of new evidence and interpretations provided by recent scientific advancements.
credited_answers: A significant portion of contemporary philosophical discourse does not revolve around the reevaluation of classical theories.
items.explanation: Negate "a significant portion" by asserting it is not true for such a portion.

items.prompt: Some economic theories posit that an increasing global interdependence leads to a redistribution of wealth that disproportionately benefits developed nations over emerging markets.
credited_answers: No economic theories posit that increasing global interdependence leads to such redistribution.
items.explanation: Negate "some" by eliminating all instances.

items.prompt: Few educational programs are structured to adequately equip students with the necessary skills to seamlessly transition into evolving job markets dominated by digital technologies and artificial intelligence.
credited_answers: Several educational programs are structured to adequately equip students with those skills.
items.explanation: Negate "few" by asserting more than just a few exist.
